label: SYNTHETIC EDUCATIONAL FINITE-VOLUME EXPERIMENT; NOT GPU/CHIP SIGNOFF; NO JEV/LLM CALLS

parameters.lateral_boundaries: adiabatic; no in-plane heat loss at four edges
parameters.source: uniform flux in fixed chiplet rectangles; exact rectangle/cell overlap integration

protocol.screened_candidates_note: Counts candidate scoring instances; duplicates within a proposal batch can occur. Not a count of globally unique layouts.
protocol.surrogate_uncertainty: No predictive uncertainty or risk-bound calibration is implemented.
protocol.objective: minimize worst plate-cell temperature across two workloads
protocol.fairness: Each method charged all 120 initial simulator samples plus 72 additions; common pool per seed. Random and local do not pay surrogate fit overhead. No claim versus frontier models.
protocol.not_RL: Surrogate-assisted search and annealing; no policy-gradient or learned routing policy.

costs.final_evaluation_calls_excluded_from_sea: 1 final verification per run; 80x80 evaluation of each finalist plus held-out workload; four winner refinement meshes

display_grid_note: Each history display_grids_C is a 10x10 area-average of the actual 40x40 solver grid, rounded to 0.001 C. Objective and workload_peak_C are full-resolution maxima, not display-grid maxima.

timing_scope.includes: Common initial sampling and simulation including its one Plate construction/factorization; additional search; final 40x40 winner verification; initial surrogate fitting and refitting where used.
timing_scope.excludes: Per-arm Plate construction/factorization; held-out accuracy evaluation; 80x80 final audit and unused workload; 20/40/80/120 mesh refinement; replay-grid generation; plot rendering; overall environment setup.
timing_scope.warning: Legacy end_to_end names do not mean full application or production latency.

geometry_gap_note: Conservative axis-aligned separation: at least one coordinate axis separates each footprint pair by 0.5 mm. This is stricter than a general Euclidean corner-clearance constraint.
limits: Synthetic powers, geometry, cooling and material assumptions; no real chip measurements.
Reports spreader plate temperature; not die junction temperature.
No chiplet timing, power delivery, interconnect length/bandwidth, reliability or manufacturability signoff.
Surrogate held-out data are drawn from the same synthetic sampling distribution; adaptive search can exploit errors.
Simulator winners are rechecked; the surrogate does not approve layouts alone.
Three seeds demonstrate feasibility; no broad statistical superiority claim.
No Jev latency/cost/calibration or actual agent token-use measurement.
Nominal parameters are deterministic; physical parameter uncertainty is not modeled.
